# hivelocity_vps_snapshot (Resource)

Takes a snapshot of a VPS volume. Snapshots are immutable; restoring one is an operational action done outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_vps_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  volume_id     = hivelocity_vps_volume.data.volume_id
  name          = "before-upgrade"
  facility_code = hivelocity_vps_volume.data.facility_code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the volume, for example `TPA1`.
- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot.
- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume to snapshot.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the snapshot was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size` (Number) Size of the snapshot.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Unique ID of the snapshot.
- `snapshot_type` (String) Type of the snapshot.
- `state` (String) State of the snapshot.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the snapshot ID
terraform import hivelocity_vps_snapshot.before_upgrade snap-abc123
```
